                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ વેચાણ કિંમત = ₹5040 + ₹860

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ વેચાણ કિંમત = ₹5900

[{"prompt": "1", "value": "172"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "180"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "270"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "260"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        20% gain in fractional form = 20 ÷ 100 = 1 ÷ 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Let Cost Price (CP) = 5 units and Profit = 1 unit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit = 5 + 1 = 6 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        6 units = ₹216 ⇒ 1 unit = 216 ÷ 6 = 36

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Cost Price (CP) = 5 units = 5 × 36 = 180

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹180.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Selling Price (SP) of the article = ₹216

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Gain percentage = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Cost Price (CP) = [100 ÷ (100 + Gain%)] × SP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = [100 ÷ (100 + 20)] × 216

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = (100 ÷ 120) × 216

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = (5 ÷ 6) × 216

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 5 × 36

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 180

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹180.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Loss Percentage

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        When Selling Price is less than Cost Price, a loss is incurred. Loss% = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Marked Price & Discount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Discount is always calculated on Marked Price (MP). Selling Price = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Successive Profit or Discount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For two successive percentage changes of a% and b%, the effective net percentage change is given by the formula: Net Change = a + b + (a × b ÷ 100).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n17d:T139", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = ₹216

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        लाभ प्रतिशत = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SP = CP × (1 + लाभ% / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        जहाँ, CP = क्रय मूल्य

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        216 = CP × (1 + 20 / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP × (1 + 0.2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP × 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 216 / 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 180

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ वस्तु की लागत ₹180 है। सही उत्तर विकल्प (2) है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "te": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఇచ్చినది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        అమ్మిన వెల (SP) = ₹216

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        లాభ శాతం = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SP = CP x (1 + లాభ% / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఇక్కడ, CP = కొన్న వెల

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        లెక్క:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        216 = CP x (1 + 20 / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP x (1 + 0.2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP x 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 216 / 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 180

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ వస్తువు యొక్క కొన్న వెల ₹180. సరైన సమాధానం ఎంపిక (2).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "mr": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        विक्री किंमत (SP) = ₹216

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        शेकडा नफा = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SP = CP × (1 + शेकडा नफा / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        येथे, CP = खरेदी किंमत

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        216 = CP × (1 + 20 / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP × (1 + 0.2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP  x  1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 216 / 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 180

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ वस्तूची किंमत ₹180 आहे. योग्य उत्तर पर्याय (2) आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "bn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        বিক্রয় মূল্য (SP) = ₹216

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        লাভের শতাংশ = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SP = CP x (1 + লাভ% / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        যেখানে, CP = ক্রয় মূল্য

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        216 = CP x (1 + 20 / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP x (1 + 0.2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP x 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 216 / 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 180

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ জিনিসটির ক্রয় মূল্য হল ₹180। সঠিক উত্তর হল বিকল্প (2)।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "ml": "", "gu": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        આપેલ છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        વેચાણ કિંમત (SP) = ₹216

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        નફાની ટકાવારી = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SP = CP x (1 + નફો% / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        જ્યાં, CP = મૂળ કિંમત

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        216 = CP x (1 + 20 / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP x (1 + 0.2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP x 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 216 / 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 180

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ વસ્તુની કિંમત ₹180 છે. સાચો જવાબ વિકલ્પ (2) છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "kn": "
