                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಮಾರಾಟ ಬೆಲೆ (SP) = ₹216

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಲಾಭದ ಶೇಕಡಾವಾರು = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SP = CP x (1 + ಲಾಭ% / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಇಲ್ಲಿ, CP = ಅಸಲು ಬೆಲೆ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        216 = CP x (1 + 20 / 100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP x (1 + 0.2)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 216 = CP x 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 216 / 1.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CP = 180

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For 2 years, the direct relation between Compound Interest (CI) and Simple Interest (SI) is:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI = SI × (1 + R ÷ 200)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 178.5 = SI × (1 + 4 ÷ 200)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 178.5 = SI × 1.02

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ SI = 178.5 ÷ 1.02 = ₹175

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹175.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Rate of interest (R) = 4% per annum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Time (T) = 2 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Compound Interest (CI) = ₹178.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI = P[(1 + R ÷ 100)T − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \nदिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (CI) = ₹178.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ब्याज दर (r) = 4% प्रति वर्ष

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        समय (t) = 2 वर्ष

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI = A - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A = P(1 + r/100)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        साधारण ब्याज (SI) = (P x r x t) / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI = ₹178.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ A - P = ₹178.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A = P(1 + r/100)t", "te": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఇచ్చినది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        చక్రవడ్డీ (CI) = ₹178.5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        వడ్డీ రేటు (r) = సంవత్సరానికి 4%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        కాలం (t) = 2 సంవత్సరాలు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI = A - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A = P(1 + r/100)t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Difference in Principal = ₹9400 − ₹5400 = ₹4000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Difference in Simple Interest for 5 years = ₹960

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Difference in Simple Interest for 1 year = 960 ÷ 5 = ₹192

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Rate % = (Interest difference for 1 year ÷ Difference in Principal) × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Rate % = (192 ÷ 4000) × 100 = 4.8%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 4.8%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मुखंड का मूलधन (P1) = ₹5400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        सचिन का मूलधन (P2) = ₹9400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        समय (t) = 5 वर्ष

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ब्याज में अंतर (I2 - I1) = ₹960

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        साधारण ब्याज (I) = \\(\\frac{P \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मुखंड का ब्याज: I1 = \\(\\frac{P_1 \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        सचिन का ब्याज: I2 = \\(\\frac{P_2 \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        अंतर: I2 - I1 = ₹960

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{P_2 \\times r \\times t}{100} - \\frac{P_1 \\times r \\times t}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{(P_2 - P_1) \\times r \\times t}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{(9400 - 5400) \\times r \\times 5}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{4000 \\times r \\times 5}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{20000 \\times r}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{200 \\times r}{1} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ r = \\(\\frac{960}{200}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ r = 4.8%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        इसलिए, सही उत्तर विकल्प (1) है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        అసలు (P2) = ₹9400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        వడ్డీలో వ్యత్యాసం (I2 - I1) = ₹960
