                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\nఇచ్చినది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        అసలు (P1) = ₹5400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        అసలు (P2) = ₹9400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        సమయం (t) = 5 సంవత్సరాలు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        వడ్డీలో వ్యత్యాసం (I2 - I1) = ₹960

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        బారు వడ్డీ (I) = \\(\\frac{P \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        లెక్కలు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ముకుంద్ కోసం వడ్డీ: I1 = \\(\\frac{P_1 \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        సచిన్ కోసం వడ్డీ: I2 = \\(\\frac{P_2 \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        తేడా: I2 - I1 = ₹960

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मुद्दल (P1) = ₹5400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मुद्दल (P2) = ₹9400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मुदत (t) = 5 वर्षे

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        व्याजामधील फरक (I2 - I1) = ₹960

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        सरळव्याज (I) = \\(\\frac{P \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मुकुंदसाठी व्याज: I1 = \\(\\frac{P_1 \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        सचिनसाठी व्याज: I2 = \\(\\frac{P_2 \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        फरक: I2 - I1 = ₹960

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒", "bn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        মূলধন (P1) = 5400 টাকা 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        মূলধন (P2) = 9400 টাকা 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        সময় (t) = 5 বছর

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        সুদের পার্থক্য (I2 - I1) = 960 টাকা 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        সরল সুদ (I) = \\(\\frac{P \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        মুকুন্দের জন্য সুদ: I1 = \\(\\frac{P_1 \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        শচীনের জন্য সুদ: I2 = \\(\\frac{P_2 \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        পার্থক্য: I2 - I1 = 960 টাকা 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{P_2 \\times r \\times t}{100} - \\frac{P_1 \\times r \\times t}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{(P_2 - P_1) \\times r \\times t}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{(9400 - 5400) \\times r \\times 5}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{4000 \\times r \\times 5}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{20000 \\times r}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{200 \\times r}{1} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ r = \\(\\frac{960}{200}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ r = 4.8%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ সঠিক উত্তরটি হল বিকল্প (1).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n185:T64f,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        આપેલ છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        મુદ્દલ (P1) = ₹5400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        મુદ્દલ (P2) = ₹9400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        સમય (t) = 5 વર્ષ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        વ્યાજનો તફાવત (I2 - I1) = ₹960

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        સ", "ml": "", "gu": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        આપેલ છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        મુદ્દલ (P1) = ₹5400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        મુદ્દલ (P2) = ₹9400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{4000 \\times r \\times 5}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{20000 \\times r}{100} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ \\(\\frac{200 \\times r}{1} = 960\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ r = \\(\\frac{960}{200}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ r = 4.8%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ સાચો જવાબ વિકલ્પ (1) છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಅಸಲು (P2) = ₹9400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಅಸಲು (P1) = ₹5400

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ಸಚಿನ್‌ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿ: I2 = \\(\\frac{P_2 \\times r \\times t}{100}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Apply the successive discount multipliers directly to the Marked Price.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Final Price = MP × (100 − D1)% × (100 − D2)%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Final Price = 30000 × 80% × 90%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Final Price = 30000 × 0.8 × 0.9 = 21600

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Marked Price (MP) = ₹30,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        First Discount (D1) = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Second Discount (D2) = 10%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Selling Price = MP − Discount Amount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Price after 1st discount = 30000 − (20% of 30000)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Price after 1st discount = 30000 − 6000 = 24000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Price after 2nd discount = 24000 − (10% of 24000)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Final Selling Price = 24000 − 2400 = 21600

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹21,600.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Effective Successive Discount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the effective single discount is calculated as: [a + b − (a × b) / 100]%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Marked Price (MP) vs Selling Price (SP)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Discount is exclusively calculated on the Marked Price. It acts as a reduction, resulting in the final Selling Price: SP = MP × (1 − Discount%).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Order Independence

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The order in which successive discounts are applied does not affect the final selling price. A 20% discount followed by a 10% discount yields the same final price as a 10% discount followed by a 20% discount.
