                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਅੰਕਿਤ ਮੁੱਲ (MP) = ₹30,000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਪਹਿਲੀ ਛੋਟ = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਦੂਜੀ ਛੋਟ = 10%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੂਤਰ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਅੰਤਿਮ ਕੀਮਤ = MP x (1 - ਪਹਿਲੀ ਛੋਟ/100) x (1 - ਦੂਜੀ ਛੋਟ/100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਗਣਨਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਅੰਤਿਮ ਕੀਮਤ = ₹30,000 x (1 - 20/100) x (1 - 10/100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਕੀਮਤ = ₹30,000 x 0.8 x 0.9

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਕੀਮਤ = ₹30,000 x 0.72

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਕੀਮਤ = ₹21,600

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ ਵਿਕਲਪ (1) ਹੈ।

"correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The numbers 20 and 40 are both exact factors of 120.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        So, the LCM of 20, 40, and 120 is simply 120 itself.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Now, we only need to find the LCM of 120 and 335.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Both 120 and 335 share a common factor of 5: 120 = 5 × 24, and 335 = 5 × 67.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        LCM = Common factor × Remaining distinct factors = 5 × 24 × 67 = 8040.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 8040.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Numbers: 40, 20, 120, and 335

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Concept Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The Least Common Multiple (LCM) is the product of the highest powers of all prime factors involved in the given numbers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Prime factorisation of 20 = 22 × 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Prime factorisation of 40 = 23 × 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Prime factorisation of 120 = 23 × 3 × 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Prime factorisation of 335 = 5 × 67

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Taking the highest power of each prime factor present:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ LCM = 23 × 31 × 51 × 671

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ LCM = 8 × 3 × 5 × 67

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ LCM = 120 × 67

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ LCM = 8040

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 8040.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        LCM (Least Common Multiple)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The smallest positive integer that is perfectly divisible by each of the given numbers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        HCF (Highest Common Factor)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The largest positive integer that divides each of the numbers without leaving any remainder.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        LCM and HCF Formula

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For any two numbers a and b, their product is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: LCM(a, b) × HCF(a, b) = a × b.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Co-prime Numbers

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Two numbers are co-prime if their HCF is 1. The LCM of two co-prime numbers is simply their direct product.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        संख्याएँ: 40, 20, 120, 335

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        LCM दी गई संख्याओं का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        अभाज्य गुणनखंडन:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        40 = 23 × 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        20 = 22 × 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        120 = 23 × 3 × 5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        335 = 5 × 67

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        LCM सभी अभाज्य गुणनखंडों की उच्चतम घातों को गुणा करके प्राप्त किया जाता है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ LCM = 23 × 3 × 5 × 67

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ LCM = 8 × 3 × 5 × 67

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ LCM = 8040

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर विकल्प (2) है।

{"prompt": "2", "value": "24420"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "24000"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "25200"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For 3 years, CI and SI difference = P × (R/100)2 × (300 + R)/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        183 = P × (5/100)2 × (305/100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        183 = P × (1/400) × (61/20)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        P = (183 × 8000) ÷ 61

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        P = 3 × 8000 = 24000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹24000.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Difference between CI and SI (D) = ₹183

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Rate of interest (R) = 5% per annum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Time period (T) = 3 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Using the Tree Ratio Method for CI (refer to diagram):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Since R = 5% = 1/20, Let Principal be DenominatorTime = (20)3 = 8000 units.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Simple Interest for each year = 5% of 8000 = 400 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Extra interest in 2nd year (CI on 1st year SI) = 5% of 400 = 20 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Extra interest in 3rd year = CI on previous SIs + CI on previous extra

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 3rd year extra = 5% of 800 + 5% of 20 = 40 + 1 = 41 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Total difference = 20 + 41 = 61 units

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Given difference = ₹183

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 61 units = ₹183 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Principal = 8000 units × 3 = ₹24000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹24000.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Tree Method Shortcut for 3 Years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For a fractional rate 1/x, if Principal = x3, the 3-year difference between CI and SI is exactly (3x + 1) units.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Difference between CI and SI for 2 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The direct formula for the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years is D = P × (R/100)2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Effective Rate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Effective SI rate = 3R. Effective CI rate ≈ 3R + 3R2/100 + R3/10000. The difference is directly (3R2/100 + R3/10000)% of Principal.
